kind: CRUD gap G3 (CRUD standard, owner scope of 5 Nov 2026): real-invoice payments and their reversals always go through a proposal that a second staff person approves (or, only when the owner allows it, the same person, marked), and every reversal carries a reason of at least 20 characters. One additive migration; real invoicing stays closed until the owner opens it offline.
findingsNote: No GAP id is created or changed. This PR closes audit gap G3 in docs/revamp/crud/summary.md; the Conductor updates that record.
sensitive: yes: real money (the real invoicing module), a database migration and staff commands. packages/auth changed one type (a payment carries a reversed flag for customers); no session, tenant-scope, consent, token or cookie logic changes. Nothing is installed anywhere by this PR; the migration is additive (one unnamed check from the first file is found by its definition and replaced under a name with the larger position limit; the same widening precedent as earlier modules) and the owner merges.
ownerDecisions: 5 Nov 2026: "Two people for both" (recording a real payment and reversing one each need a second staff member's approval; every reversal carries a reason).

6 Nov 2026, single-approver switch and real payments: "Yes, marked (Recommended)". Only when the owner turns allow_single_approver on, one person may record or reverse a real payment; every such record is marked self_approved=true and the named finance approver still applies. With the switch off, two different people always.
6 Nov 2026, reason length for real reversals: "20 characters (Recommended)". Credit notes keep their current rule (10).
changed: packages/db/customer-invoicing-real-migrations/0002_payment_approval_and_reversal.sql (new, additive, never applied anywhere): proposal kinds payment and payment_reversal with named checks; payments record the approved proposal they came from; table real_invoice_payment_reversal (append-only, one reversal per payment, reason of at least 20 characters, row security on, no runtime or auth access); guards on payments and reversals that demand an approved proposal in both modes; the command log accepts prepare_payment and prepare_payment_reversal; the one-person payment command is refused in every mode; position checks reach 1500; staff read functions and the command are replaced with the same signatures.

packages/delivery/src/customer-invoicing-real-staff.ts: the staff command accepts prepare_payment and prepare_payment_reversal; REVERSAL_REASON_MIN = 20; position limit 1500; the made-up-supplier check for approvals runs after the command and fails closed (only a payment or the reversal of one passes).

apps/web/app/operator/customer-real-invoicing.tsx: a payment is always prepared and then approved (no one-person Record Payment button in any mode); a Prepare Payment Reversal form with a 20 character minimum; waiting payments and reversals appear in Waiting for approval with Approve and Reject and show money with the invoice currency; approving a reversal asks once in a dialog (CRUD D-02).
packages/auth/src/customer-invoicing-real.ts and apps/web/app/account/billing/real-invoices-section.tsx: customers see that a payment was reversed, never why.
preserved: Payments, credits and invoices stay append-only: a payment is never edited or deleted, and stays readable with its reversal.
Exact money: whole minor units as text; what is paid is derived, never stored; currencies are never added or converted.

Every existing command, guard, event kind and customer read behaves as before. Prepared payments run the same checks as before at preparation (amount, date, reference, position), and approval repeats them.
The real invoicing control is untouched and stays closed until the owner opens it offline.
Events carry ids, the number and a sequence only, never the amount, the date, the reference or the reason.

behaviour.approval: A payment or reversal is prepared by one person and decided by another. The same person cannot approve while a second person is required; the named finance approver, when the supplier details name one, is the only approver, as for invoices.
behaviour.oneApprover: Only when the owner has recorded that one person may do both, the same person prepares and approves; the record is marked self approved and the named finance approver still applies.
behaviour.directPayment: The one-person payment command is refused in every mode ("A payment is prepared first and then approved: prepare it for approval"). The staff screen has no one-person payment button.
behaviour.tableGuards: No payment row and no reversal row can be written without an approved proposal of the right kind and invoice, by anyone, in either mode.
behaviour.afterReversal: The reversed amount is owed again. A payment is reversed once, and one reversal of a payment can wait at a time.
behaviour.stale: Approval of a payment or reversal prepared against an older state of the invoice is refused ("prepare it again").
behaviour.madeupSupplier: Approvals are judged after the command on what it returned: a payment or the reversal of one passes; any other kind (an invoice, a credit note, anything added later, or no kind) is treated as a document and refused while supplier details are made up, rolling the whole command back. A retry after a lost reply replays the recorded result.

databaseLimits.proposalPosition: expected_position BETWEEN 0 AND 1500 on the credit, payment and payment reversal proposal checks (real_invoicing_proposal_credit_check, ..._payment_check, ..._reversal_check). Tested: a catalog test; inserts at 1001 and 1500 accepted and 1501 refused for each kind; a real prepare at position 1001 for a payment, credit note and reversal.
databaseLimits.reversalReasonMinimum: 20, from customer_private.real_reversal_reason_min(), used by the proposal check, the reversal table check and the command. Tested: the SQL command called directly refuses 19 characters (code 23514, 'at least 20 characters') and accepts 20; the reversal table's own check refuses 19 and accepts 20 with the guard off; the delivery schema and the staff screen constant equal 20 (the textarea minlength is asserted); a reversal row with no approved proposal is refused with one person allowed and with a second person required.
